title: Combobox
description: Type to filter, arrows to choose — the Select for lists too long to scan.
usage: For long option lists: frameworks, countries, customers. Under a dozen options, a Select is faster and needs no JavaScript.
a11y: Labeled editable combobox with list autocomplete, per-instance listbox/option IDs, expanded and active-descendant state, and a result-count status region. Arrow keys, Home and End navigate available options; Enter selects, Escape closes, and Tab leaves without selecting. Focus stays in the input; IME composition does not select an option. No-results text is outside the listbox. Supports multiple instances, repeated script loading, RTL and reduced motion. Browser and screen-reader combinations still need manual testing. Focus, click and Alt+ArrowDown show all options. Only typing filters and announces counts; data-combo-result-one and data-combo-result-many customize messages with {count}.
